protocol.model: the year-blocked cross-validation models of the v3-live configuration, each scoring the years it did not train on (out-of-fold, the setting the card's thresholds were set in)
protocol.note: chosen on development years only; test_2018, the 2023 window, Wayanad 2024 and the live days are not read

choice.rule: A = 0.25 (pre-declared) unless the disagreeing Warning+ alerts are at least as precise (events per alerted cell-day) as the agreeing ones; then the disagreement is reported as a flag only

hold_window.rule: per level, the shortest hold window meeting the adoption rule at that level; the combination must meet it at every gated level

choice.rule: H = the largest k in [1, 2, 3] whose retention is at least 0.5 at every level, and at least 1 (pre-declared)

before.label: before: old interval, no post-model rules

adoption.rule: a challenger replaces the selected v3 configuration only if its pooled OOF FA@90 is lower by MORE than the bootstrap SE of the paired difference

choice.rule: higher exact level agreement with the observed-feature level (pooled over leads 1-3); a tie to three decimals goes to the lower forecast Watch+ share (pre-declared)
